name: Net Identity
description:
Panel indicator for your current network identity: public IP address, VPN/WireGuard/Tailscale state, DNS resolvers, primary connection, and LAN addresses. Click a row to copy its value to the clipboard (write-only; this extension does not read the clipboard). Notifies when the public IP changes.

Network access: this extension may request your public IP from api.ipify.org, ifconfig.me, or icanhazip.com. Responses are kept in memory only for the session. Local connection details come from NetworkManager and /etc/resolv.conf. No accounts and no telemetry.
